state.intent: The user says the Daily Consensus logo is misaligned and the whole design is rough and overloaded. Refine the production morning market dashboard into a polished, calm, visual briefing for a coffee-length scan.
state.platform: Next16 React19 CSS modules; 390px phones, 768px tablets and desktop. No runtime model calls. Real interactive controls, sources, history, keyboard navigation and 44px hit areas.
catalog: consensus card with label, coverage, family votes and source dialog
Treasury curve, liquidity sparkline, FX sparklines
upcoming catalysts and full calendar disclosure
three reviewed primary developments with original facts/interpretation/source links
current_problems: Logo uses two independently styled words and skewed bars; spacing/baselines feel accidental.
Three equally weighted verdict columns with giant empty gauge and repeated warnings dominate first screen.
Marketing headline and many metadata lines delay usable information.
Every research section is expanded and long text cards dominate.
Tiny grey 10-12px body labels, dark-blue panels everywhere.
constraints: Preserve saved edition and all data values/dates. No fabricated price, sentiment or accuracy.
Withheld verdict and directional coverage must stay prominent; observation coverage is separate, never accuracy.
Source links/limitations and archived isolation remain available.
Existing mint mark, dark/light preference and navigation retained. Semantic headings and reduced motion.
No cosmetic call that looks bullish when engine abstains.

proposed_tokens.palette: matte charcoal/near-black, warm off-white text, muted sage/mint accent, restrained amber for coverage; semantic red/green only for real measured changes
proposed_tokens.type: Self-hosted Space Grotesk display and Manrope body, generous 13-15px reading sizes, tabular data
proposed_tokens.spacing: 4px rhythm; 24-32px sections; 1120-1240px max reading width; 8-12px panel radii

state.evidence: Current MARKET daily 20% voting coverage (3/15 families), about55% observation coverage. All18 calls abstain. Many integrations missing; show honestly without an oversized empty gauge.

first_screen.instructions: Choose the strongest morning hierarchy under these constraints.

criteria.briefing: Compact dated intro, instrument/horizon controls, tabs, two-column consensus and evidence summary; next catalysts and concise reviewed headlines follow.
criteria.terminal: Minimal intro, dense equal-sized dashboard grid with every research category at once.
criteria.editorial: Large magazine-style title, lead news feature then verdict and controls below.
criteria.none_fit: None fit; expand candidates before coding.

withheld_visual.instructions: Choose the visual for an abstaining consensus. Must distinguish absent data from neutral and keep coverage explicit.

criteria.family_grid: 15 labelled family cells with voting/context/missing states; prominent20% directional coverage; exact reasons in disclosure. No gauge until qualified.
criteria.neutral_gauge: Retain large blank semicircular gauge and greyed votes; separate text for coverage.
criteria.stacked_bars: Two large horizontal bars for directional and observation coverage, family vote list below; reasons in disclosure.
criteria.none_fit: None fit; expand candidates before coding.

brand.instructions: Choose a compact brand lockup to resolve baseline and spacing issues throughout morning and research desk.

criteria.two_line: Small THE DAILY over a stronger consensus. on a shared left edge, four aligned unskewed bars in a fixed square, explicit line heights and gap.
criteria.one_line: One-line The Daily Consensus wordmark beside the existing four-bar mark, wrapping only on phone.
criteria.word_only: Remove mark and use a large uppercase editorial wordmark.
criteria.none_fit: None fit; expand candidates before coding.

detail.instructions: Choose progressive disclosure for the long morning page, preserving source access and meaningful visuals.

criteria.grouped: Keep rates/liquidity/FX visuals and concise reviewed headlines open. Place institutional/policy/flows and news/earnings in clearly named research sections with short visible summaries and expandable detail. Load hosted charts on explicit open.
criteria.all_open: Keep every chart and prose paragraph expanded, reduce font size and compress gaps.
criteria.tabs_only: Move all macro panels to Every signal; morning shows verdict and news only.
criteria.none_fit: None fit; expand candidates before coding.

news_cards.instructions: Choose how reviewed developments should be shown without changing editorial facts or interpretation.

criteria.headline_disclosure: Show date, title, transmission channel and explicit expand action; reveal full facts, separate interpretation and original source links on open.
criteria.facts_always: Show full facts and interpretation on all three cards, hide only source details.
criteria.single_feature: Only first article visible; remaining articles hidden under next/previous arrows.
criteria.none_fit: None fit; expand candidates before coding.

criteria.wrap: Six compact instrument buttons in wrapping row/grid with no hidden options; daily/weekly/monthly in44px group below on phone.
criteria.select_horizon: Six instrument buttons; labelled native horizon select beside desktop and below on phone,44px high.
criteria.scroll: Keep long horizontal scroll strip with partly hidden buttons and horizon pills below.
